items.title: Arsenal East unveils VIBE in Jumeirah Garden City
items.summary: VIBE offers 207 fully furnished homes in Satwa's Jumeirah Garden City: 153 one-bedroom apartments and 54 studios. Pricing, payment plan and handover were not disclosed.

items.title: Tabeer hands over Dh250m 48 Parkside in Arjan
items.summary: Tabeer Developments has completed and handed over its Dh250 million 48 Parkside project of one- to three-bedroom residences in Arjan, roughly 24 months after starting, with residents now moving in.

items.project: JW Marriott Residences Abu Dhabi – Yas Island
items.title: TARAF and Steppe sign deal to launch JW Marriott Residences on Yas Island
items.summary: Yas Holding's TARAF and Singapore's Steppe agreed to launch a beachfront, golf-side JW Marriott-branded residential development on Yas Island, Marriott's second project with TARAF. Unit count, prices and handover were not disclosed.

items.project: One&Only Private Residences Al Maryah Island
items.title: Mubadala, TARAF and Kerzner plan One&Only residences tower on Al Maryah Island
items.summary: A roughly 230-metre, 44-floor One&Only branded tower with one- to three-bedroom homes, duplexes and a penthouse, signed at LIVEX 2026. Unit count, pricing and handover were not stated.

items.title: H&H's Water Gardens in DIFC targets completion within two years
items.summary: The 1.8 million sq ft mixed-use scheme includes Four Seasons Private Residences, reported 85% sold, plus the Eden House furnished apartments, offices and a hotel; tenants are expected within 18-20 months.
